From: Alex Carter <alex.carter@veridian.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sizing request: Dedicated capacity for Veridian Labs - GenAssist

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — Veridian is ramping GenAssist (an LLM-powered coding assistant) to a public beta in Q3 and we want to explore a Dedicated cluster with Redwood. Attaching a week of sampled traffic (veridian_traffic_sample_q1.csv) for context. High-level asks:

- Baseline sizing recommendation (GPU count/SKU) for 95th percentile peak,
- Expected p95/p99 latencies for interactive chat (SLO target: p95 < 250ms),
- Canary/burst strategy and recommended redundancy,
- Rough monthly cost ballpark (reserved + burst).

Quick background: currently ~10k MAU in private beta, we expect 3x growth during beta/marketing push. Traffic today is mostly chat completions with occasional embeddings for search rerank. We can provide more telemetry if needed.

Appreciate any initial guidance — happy to hop on a 30m call this week.

Thanks,
Alex Carter
Director of Platform
Veridian Labs
Attachments: veridian_traffic_sample_q1.csv (CSV, 72KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Sizing request: Dedicated capacity for Veridian Labs - GenAssist

Hi Alex — thanks for the sample, this is perfect to start.

A few clarifying questions that will materially change sizing:

1) Typical prompt and completion lengths (tokens): median and 95th?
2) Percent of requests that are streaming vs. non-streaming (streaming affects latency/cost).
3) Session affinity: do users keep KV-cached sessions (long lived) or are sessions stateless?
4) Expected peak concurrency (RPS or concurrent sessions) during your marketing push and the expected peak window duration.
5) Any regulatory constraints (data residency, private VPC) that will affect placement.

I attached our short Dedicated Intake Form to capture these (redwood_dedicated_intake_form.pdf). If you can fill the few missing points we’ll run a quick sizing hypothesis and Marissa will follow up with a preliminary capacity sketch.

If you prefer a call, Marissa, Karthik and I are available Thu/Fri morning PT — let me know what works.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex.carter@veridian.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sizing request: Dedicated capacity for Veridian Labs - GenAssist

Alex / Kimberly — pulling together a quick hypothesis based on the sample and typical GenAssist patterns. High-level assumptions (please confirm):

- Model family: opt for an MPT-30B-like open variant with quantization option for cost parity; if Veridian prefers smaller latency we can map to gpt-style variants.
- Median prompt: 200-400 tokens, median response: 800-1400 tokens (we'll adjust once you confirm).
- 90-95% interactive chat completions, 5-10% batch embeddings/rerank.
- Target p95 latency <= 250ms (interactive) — requires shorter decode windows + batching limits.

Preliminary sizing (95th percentile peak):
- Conservative: 8x A100 80GB equivalent (supports sustained concurrency ~350-450 concurrent chat sessions with optimized batching and KV caching)
- Cost-optimized: 12x A10g mix + aggressive quantization (higher ops per dollar, lower tail latency predictability)

Canary/burst suggestion: reserve 70% of baseline and keep a 20% burst pool + cross-region fallback. Autoscale policy: proactive warm-up for predicted marketing spikes (scheduled scaling + short-term burst).

I'll prepare a short workbook with assumed token distributions and estimated throughput (attached initial-hypothesis.xlsx) — once you confirm token stats and session affinity we can produce a more precise GPU count and an ops/cost breakdown.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: initial-hypothesis.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)
From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@veridian.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sizing request: Dedicated capacity for Veridian Labs - GenAssist

Hi team — quick clarifications from our product/infra side:

- Median prompt length ~300 tokens, 95th ~900 tokens.
- Median response ~1,200 tokens, 95th ~3,500 tokens.
- ~92% chat completions, ~8% embeddings/rerank.
- Session behavior: users typically have sticky sessions with KV-caching for a single user session (~30 min average), but KV cache is not required to survive across days.
- Peak: expecting ~600 concurrent sessions during the 2-week marketing push (spiky windows of 10–15 minutes).
- Data residency: US only for now (VPC preferred).

We are also very sensitive to cold-start p99 spikes — including a canary and a warm standby would be great to see in the proposal.

Happy to jump on the call Thu 10:00am PT if that helps.

Best,
Jordan Miles
VP Product, Veridian Labs
